test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A statement is given followed by four conclusions as options. Select which conclusion is true based on the given statement

**Statement:** R > M = N < Q < P = J
solution: Given Statement: R > M = N Conclusions: Option 1: J > M → True (J = P > Q > N = M, It gives J > M)
